children: INSIDE INFORMATION: YIT DOUBLES ITS GROUP REVENUE GROWTH TARGET FOR THE STRATEGY PERIOD DRIVEN BY THE EXPANDING DATA CENTER MARKET IN FINLAND
TARGETS GROUP REVENUE GROWTH OF AT LEAST 10% CAGR BY END OF 2029
MAINTAINS ADJUSTED OPERATING PROFIT MARGIN TARGET OF AT LEAST 7% BY END OF 2029
INCREASES SEGMENT REVENUE GROWTH TARGETS FOR BUILDING CONSTRUCTION AND INFRASTRUCTURE
BUILDING CONSTRUCTION SEGMENT TARGETS AT LEAST 6% CAGR, INFRASTRUCTURE SEGMENT AT LEAST 15% CAGR BY 2029
